about: Sound events for the pack opening (src/audio/audio.js). Raw files live in audio-src/ and are levelled into this folder by scripts/master-audio.mjs, which sets how loud each one is; a missing file stays silent. duration is the ideal length in seconds, matched to the animation. loop: plays seamlessly until stopped. bus: music / fx / voice. group: events in one group cut each other off (the newest wins). duck: lowers music and effects while it plays. minGap / maxVoices stop pile-ups. The world: a dark, quiet card showroom with a thin green neon line round the walls, spotlights, foil packs and printed trading cards of Genji Ball players (a blade-and-ball arcade sport). Premium and polished, with arcade punch on the big pulls. No speech except the announcer events.

music-stage.prompt: Three-minute instrumental, one file per track in music/ (japan, lofi), made with scripts/gen-music.mjs.

pack-shimmer.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. A thin foil trading card booster pack gently turned in the hand, soft quiet foil crinkle.

pack-tap.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. A fingertip tapping once on a sealed foil booster pack, soft crinkly thud.

tension.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. Fingers squeezing and gripping a foil booster pack, foil crinkling tighter and tighter.

tear.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. Tearing open the top of a foil trading card booster pack in one quick pull, crisp foil rip.

burst.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. A foil wrapper pulled apart and trading cards sliding out of it, foil rustle then a soft riffle of card stock.

card-whoosh.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. One stiff playing card flicked quickly through the air, short soft swish.

card-land.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. One thick playing card dropped flat onto a felt table, single soft tap.

card-hover.prompt: Seamless 3 s loop while a face-down card is lifted under a finger or cursor, the same for every card (it must not hint at what the card is): a faint, soft neutral air tone with a whisper of green neon hum, quiet and expectant.

flip-common.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. One playing card turned over on a table by hand, single crisp card snap.

flip-rare.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. One playing card slid along a table and turned over, short slide then a firm card snap.

flip-epic.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. A thick card bent slightly then flipped over and slapped flat on a wooden table, firm snap.

flip-legendary.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. A heavy card slowly dragged across a wooden table, lifted, then slapped down hard, weighty thud.

flip-mythic.prompt: Realistic recording, no music, no synthesizer: a dark quiet room, two slow deep muffled heartbeats, then a heavy stone slab slowly turned and set down with a deep low thud.

sting-rare.prompt: Realistic recording, no synthesizer: a single small glass chime struck once, clear and soft, short natural ring.

sting-epic.prompt: Realistic recording, no synthesizer: a crystal singing bowl struck once softly, warm shimmering ring fading out.

sting-legendary.prompt: Realistic recording, no synthesizer: a large brass bell struck once with a soft mallet, rich warm golden tone, long natural decay.

sting-mythic.prompt: Realistic recording, no synthesizer: one huge deep taiko drum hit in a large hall, low boom, then quiet crackling embers of a fire in the tail.

announce-mythic.prompt: Announcer, quiet and in awe, one word: "Mythic." Made per voice with scripts/gen-voice.mjs.

collect.prompt: Close-mic foley recording, dry studio, no music, no synthesizer, no reverb. A small stack of playing cards gathered up and squared against a table, quick shuffle and two soft taps.
